name: Shimomura Isao
source:
Kida's best friend and Maho's boyfriend. 
Isao can be considered the opposite of Kida, and as such is outgoing and more of an optimist. 

He is completely focused on his plans for spending Christmas with Maho[Spoiler], but is unaware of how uncomfortable she feels about the prospect of sex and sexuality during their time together.[/spoiler]

[From [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/December_When_There_Is_No_Angel]Wikipedia[/url]]
